timed_events.message: The sun drops lower. The crowd grows restless. Hungry faces turn toward the disciples.
The sun is almost gone. Five thousand hungry people and I still have no answer. I must finish this now.

triggered_events.message: Five thousand men. At least. Plus women and children — the true number could be ten thousand or more.
200 denarii. Eight months' wages. And even that wouldn't be enough — just 'a little' for each person.
The teacher says: 'Have the people sit down.'
Five loaves and two fish. Andrew's question echoes: 'What are these among so many?'
The crowd is seated. Groups of fifty. Groups of a hundred. The hillside is organized like a feast.
The food is gathered. The crowd is seated. Everything is ready. The teacher takes the basket from the boy.
5,000 fed. From five loaves and two fish. The basket never emptied. The bread was always warm.
The crowd declares: 'This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.'
אות — Sign. The feeding of the five thousand was not just a meal. It was a sign.
Five loaves. Two fish. Five thousand fed. Twelve baskets left over. The math doesn't work. It never did. And now you understand — it was never supposed to.
